tools.name: list_tracks
tools.title: List tracks
tools.description: Lists the tracks that train mode offers (campaign A and B, user, workshop), with size, lap score, challenge progress, and whether they are locked. Also describes the random-track options for start_training.

source.description: Which tracks to list. Default: all.

tools.name: get_leaderboard
tools.title: Get track leaderboard
tools.description: Downloads and returns the game's retrieved leaderboard page for a trainable track. The page is limited to the game's cached top entries and may not contain a rally car.

tools.name: get_training_status
tools.title: Get training status
tools.description: Current scene and, while training, the track, generation timer, speed, pause state, and for each network the live generation (cars, active cars, best score, best lap) and the last completed generation. Call this first.

tools.name: start_training
tools.title: Start training
tools.description: Starts train mode with one or more saved networks on a named track or on random tracks (a new random track every generation). Optionally applies training settings first (same fields as update_training_settings) and sets the speed. Waits until the first generation runs. Several networks need the game's multi-train option; they share the population.

networks.description: Networks to train (1 unless multi-train is enabled).

track.description: A track name, {"name": ..., "source": ...}, or {"random": {length, allow_double_connections, surfaces, surface_distribution}}.

length.description: Track length in tiles (see list_tracks random.length).

allow_double_connections.description: Allow all tile types, not only simple ones (default: the menu's last choice).

settings.description: Training settings to apply before starting; same fields as update_training_settings.

speed.description: Legacy speed alias. Use either speed or multiplier. 'fast' uses the installed speed patch.

multiplier.description: Runtime speed multiplier, in whole steps. No SpeedMod rebuild needed. Mutually exclusive with speed.

replace_active.description: End a running training or race session first; its unsaved progress is lost (default false).

tools.name: set_random_track_config
tools.title: Set next random-track configuration
tools.description: Changes the random-track length, connection mode, and surfaces for the next generation without restarting the training session or discarding its population. The current track geometry stays unchanged.

length.description: Track length in tiles (see list_tracks random.length).

allow_double_connections.description: Allow all tile types, not only simple ones.

tools.name: stop_training
tools.title: Stop training
tools.description: Ends the training session like the Home button and returns to the main menu. Unsaved progress is lost unless auto_save is on; call save_trained_network first to keep the best car.

tools.name: set_paused
tools.title: Pause or resume
tools.description: Pauses or resumes the simulation, like the play button.

paused.description: true to pause, false to resume.

tools.name: skip_generation
tools.title: Skip generation
tools.description: Ends the current generation now and breeds the next one, like the skip button.

tools.name: set_speed
tools.title: Set speed
tools.description: Sets runtime simulation speed from 1x to 16x in integer steps, or selects a legacy speed alias. Updates physics timing and the speed display. Status includes measured throughput; requested speed is not guaranteed.

multiplier.description: Runtime speed multiplier. Pass exactly one of multiplier or speed.

speed.description: Legacy speed alias, mutually exclusive with multiplier.

tools.name: save_trained_network
tools.title: Save trained network
tools.description: Saves a network from the running session as a user network, like the save button: the best car of the current generation (best_current) or of the previous one (best_previous), with its training history. Saving over an existing user network (including the one being trained) needs overwrite: true.

network.description: Session network name (required when several train).

save_as.description: Name to save under (default: the network's name).

overwrite.description: Replace an existing user network with that name (default false).

tools.name: get_training_metrics
tools.title: Get training metrics
tools.description: Per-generation history: score distribution (best, quartiles, average, worst), best lap, speeds, and the settings each generation ran with (mutation rate, selection, crossover, weight decay, rewards). Reads the running session, or a saved network's history when network/source name one that is not training.

source.description: Read a saved network from this source instead of the session.

since_generation.description: Start at this generation index instead of the last N.

tools.name: wait_for_generation
tools.title: Wait for generation
tools.description: Waits until a network in the session has completed more generations, then returns the new generations and the status. Use it to observe training between setting changes without polling.

generations.description: How many more generations to wait for (default 1).

min_generation.description: Wait until the network's total generation count reaches this instead.

tools.name: capture_screenshot
tools.title: Capture screenshot
tools.description: Renders the whole track, centered and zoomed out to fit, with the cars where they are, and returns it as a PNG image. Without generation and at_time_s it captures now. Otherwise it waits until that generation's timer reaches at_time_s (0.1 s steps; default 0), pauses the game at exactly that moment, captures, and resumes unless keep_paused. Default generation: the running one, or the next if its timer is already past at_time_s. The game keeps no replays, so only the running or a later generation can be captured. The in-game camera and UI are not changed and the image shows no UI. Needs a game window (not --headless) that is not minimized.

at_time_s.description: Generation time to capture at, in seconds (0.1 s steps).

generation.description: Generation index as in get_training_metrics; the running generation's index is the network's generation count.

network.description: Session network whose generations are counted (required when several train).

size.description: Longest side of the image in pixels (default 1600).

keep_paused.description: Leave the game paused after a timed capture (default false).

timeout_s.description: Maximum wait for the moment, in seconds (default 120, max 300).

tools.name: get_training_settings
tools.title: Get training settings
tools.description: The current training settings (global, like the in-game panel), the allowed range and step of each value, and when changes take effect during training.

tools.name: update_training_settings
tools.title: Update training settings
tools.description: Changes training settings within the in-game panel's limits; values are rounded to the panel's steps like the UI would. Works during training (most values apply at the next generation) and keeps the in-game panel in sync. Settings persist, like changes made in the panel.

mutation_rate.description: Scale of random changes to weights and biases when breeding.

adaptive_mutation.description: Scale mutation by network shape and size.

population.description: Cars per generation (total when several networks train).

auto_skip.description: Start the next generation when all cars are out.

idle_eliminate.description: Eliminate cars that stop making progress.

weight_decay.description: Shrinks weights toward zero each generation.

preserve_parents.description: Copy the best parents unchanged into the next generation.

preserve_parents_size.description: How many parents to keep with preserve_parents on_custom.

type.description: default or average; must be supported by the metric (default: the metric's first type).

weight.description: Weight; negative values penalize. Weights are normalized by their absolute sum.

rewards.description: Replaces the whole reward list: 1 to 5 metrics, each once.

auto_save.description: Save the network automatically (single-network training only).

grid.description: Starting grid (needs the experimental vehicle collision option).

collision_mode.description: Car-to-car collisions (needs the experimental vehicle collision option).

tools.name: get_physics_scene
tools.title: Export training physics scene
tools.description: Returns live vehicle body and wheel parameters, track walls, polygons, surfaces, baked path and score Curve2D control points.

tools.name: get_physics_network
tools.title: Export active training network
tools.description: Returns the sole active agent's exact input order, output order, shape, weights and biases.

tools.name: probe_physics_pose
tools.title: Query native contact points at a recorded pose
tools.description: Runs Godot's shape collision query for the training car rectangle at an arbitrary body pose.

annotations.title: Query native contact points at a recorded pose

tools.name: start_physics_trace
tools.title: Record controlled car physics
tools.description: Records physics-frame states from one car. With preserve_network true, the trained network stays intact; otherwise the tool temporarily gives it constant outputs in memory for this generation only.

frames.description: Number of physics frames, from 1 to 2400.

acceleration.description: Constant acceleration output, strictly between -1 and 1.

steering.description: Constant steering output, strictly between -1 and 1.

brake.description: Constant brake output, strictly between -1 and 1.

preserve_network.description: Use the trained network's real sensor-driven outputs (default false).

reset.description: Reset the vehicle to the track start before recording (default true).

tools.name: get_physics_trace
tools.title: Retrieve recorded car physics
tools.description: Returns the captured frames, actual output and sensor values, and whether recording has finished.

limit.description: Maximum frames to return (default 200, 0 for status only).

tools.name: get_catalog
tools.title: Get catalog
tools.description: Everything needed to build valid requests: vehicle types, sensor and output types with this player's unlock state, hidden-layer and vision-sensor limits, paint patterns and palette colors, reward metrics, training option names, and random-track options. Call this before create_network or update_training_settings.

tools.name: list_networks
tools.title: List networks
tools.description: Lists saved networks (the game calls them AIs or evolutions) with vehicle type, shape, sensors, outputs, training generations, and whether they are locked or editable. Sources: user (editable), builtin, workshop, race.

source.description: Which saved networks to list. Default: all.

tools.name: get_network
tools.title: Get network
tools.description: Details of one saved network: sensors, outputs, layer shape, vehicle and paint, best lap and score per track, and optionally the weights and the per-generation training history.

name.description: Network name, as shown by list_networks.

source.description: Where to look. If omitted, all sources are searched.

include_history.description: Include all training generations (default false; see get_training_metrics).

tools.name: create_network
tools.title: Create network
tools.description: Creates and saves a new user network with the in-game editor's rules: 1-13 vision sensors at angles in steps of 5 degrees (their length is set by the game from the angle), up to 7 other sensors (each type once, unlocked only), outputs (steering and acceleration are always on), up to 10 hidden layers of 1-16 neurons, and a paint job from the palette. Omitted fields use defaults: formula, vision [-90,-30,0,30,90], sensors [grip, speed], hidden [3], white paint.

name.description: Name for the new user network.

items.description: Angle in degrees, -180..180, multiple of 5; 0 is straight ahead.

outputs.description: Outputs; steering and acceleration are always included.

init.description: Initial weights for new connections (default random).

pattern.description: Pattern key from get_catalog skin.patterns, e.g. solid.

primary.description: A palette color name, or {"color": name, "lightness": step}. See get_catalog skin.colors.

secondary.description: A palette color name, or {"color": name, "lightness": step}. See get_catalog skin.colors.

tertiary.description: A palette color name, or {"color": name, "lightness": step}. See get_catalog skin.colors.

skin.description: Paint job. primary/secondary/tertiary are needed as the pattern's color count requires.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing user network with this name (default false).

tools.name: duplicate_network
tools.title: Duplicate network
tools.description: Copies any unlocked network (for example a builtin one) to a new user network, keeping weights and history. Use it before editing builtin or workshop networks.

source.description: Where the network is. If omitted, all sources are searched.

new_name.description: Name of the new user network.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing user network with that name (default false).

tools.name: update_network
tools.title: Update network
tools.description: Changes a user network like the in-game editor: sensors and outputs keep the trained weights of those that stay; hidden-layer changes keep overlapping weights; new connections get init weights. Pass only what should change. vision_angles and sensors each replace their whole list. Networks in the running training session cannot be edited.

items.description: Angle in degrees, -180..180, multiple of 5; 0 is straight ahead.

outputs.description: Outputs; steering and acceleration are always included.

init.description: Initial weights for new connections (default random).

pattern.description: Pattern key from get_catalog skin.patterns, e.g. solid.

primary.description: A palette color name, or {"color": name, "lightness": step}. See get_catalog skin.colors.

secondary.description: A palette color name, or {"color": name, "lightness": step}. See get_catalog skin.colors.

tertiary.description: A palette color name, or {"color": name, "lightness": step}. See get_catalog skin.colors.

skin.description: Paint job. primary/secondary/tertiary are needed as the pattern's color count requires.

overwrite.description: When renaming, replace an existing user network with the new name (default false).

new_name.description: Rename the network (saves under the new name, then removes the old file).

reinitialize.description: Reset all weights and the training history.

reset_history.description: Clear the training history but keep the weights (default false).
